selection_evidence_scope: Only DDPM-10 baseline calibration from protocol v0.1 was inspected; no other controlled configuration result was used.
rationale: The v0.1 60 s timeout saturated success at 18/18. A single global 15.5 s navigation budget is fixed for every scene, method, seed, and stabilizer stratum to create a time-constrained non-saturated task without changing success radius, controller, topomap, geometry, checkpoint, or candidate semantics.

gate.retain_if: At least one stabilizer stratum has nontrivial success (strictly between 0 and 1) or nontrivial path/failure variance, while the scene is not mechanically broken across both strata.
reject_if: success is 0/6 or 6/6 with no meaningful efficiency/failure variance
both stabilizer strata are universally impossible
physics is broken or raw records are invalid
a rule would need per-method adjustment
